| Header line | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `#! program` | `build/docs-examples/bin/tut02_widgets` | the program, from the repository root (required) |
| `#! args` | `--flag value` | its arguments |
| `#! frames` | `180` | frames to record (required) |
| `#! from` | `0` | frames to skip before recording (default 0) |
| `#! poster` | `150` | the recorded frame saved as the still image (default: last) |
| `#! video` | `no` | a still image only (default: yes when frames > 1) |
| `#! crop` | `x y w h` | a fixed crop [pixels] (default: the content's bounding box) |
| `#! scale` | `960` | width of the video and poster [pixels] (default: the crop's) |
| `#! crf` | `26` | H.264 quality, lower is better and larger (default 26) |
| `#! style` | `seal` | the program's style, through FIGURE_STYLE (default seal) |
| `#! gif` | `640` | also an animated GIF of the video, this wide (for the README: GitHub plays no repository video there) |
| `#! keys` |  | a caption of each key chord pressed, at the bottom of the video, for 1.5 s (`ctrl+s`, `down`, `f5`) |
| `#! pointer` | `no` | no pointer drawn (default: the pointer is drawn in a video once the script moves it, ringed while a button is held) |
| `#! remote` | `1100 700` | remote mode: the program is started with its args, then "--remote PORT", and a headless Chromium (CHROME, or puppeteer's) draws the page at this size; the still gets a browser bar (no input script) |
| `#! fresh` | `/tmp/figure-studio` | a folder under /tmp removed before the program starts: what the program writes there (--examples DIR) is not an earlier run's |
| `#! mask` | `x y w h` | --check: a rectangle of the poster [pixels] left out (a clock, anything drawn from the wall time); one line each |
| `#! mask.darwin` | `x y w h` | --check: as mask, on that platform only (`linux`, `darwin`, `win32`): what is drawn there from its arithmetic |
| `#! check` | `threshold=2 max_failed=0` | --check's tolerance (the defaults shown); `#! check.linux`, `check.darwin`, `check.win32`: for that platform only, where a difference was measured there; `skip` there: the recording is not compared on that platform (a comment says why) (FIGURE_CAPTURE_HEADLESS=1: no window, no display, no GPU), the pictures --check compares with (#7 S9 records the site this way) (FIGURE_CAPTURE_HEADLESS=1: no window, no GPU) and compare the poster with the committed one: per channel |d| <= 2, no pixel more (the #! check and #! mask lines aside); on a failure writes docs/public/media/<name>.new.png, <name>.diff.png and the font atlas the poster was drawn with, <name>.atlasK.png; exit status 1 if any failed <name>.png; the .diff.png removed) |
